data.thought: The export still fails because frame.csv is not created; adjust the epilogue to explicitly write the data frame to frame.csv after confirming the required objects exist.

args.instructions: Update the R epilogue to: 1) After the main script finishes, verify that the objects sc, Xs, pd, decision, cf, and fit exist. 2) If sc exists, write it to '/work/out/frame.csv' using write.csv(sc, file.path('/work/out', 'frame.csv'), row.names = FALSE). 3) If Xs exists and sc does not, write Xs to frame.csv similarly. 4) Export pd and decision to '/work/out/scores.csv' (combine with a .row index). 5) Export cf (or coefficients derived from fit) to '/work/out/coef.csv'. 6) Ensure the output directory '/work/out' is created if missing. Include comments explaining each step.
